# Melanie

- Friend of Caroline
- Mother with kids
- Works full-time alongside parenting

## Hobbies
- Painting — paints landscapes and still life, including sunflowers (as of 2023-08-25); creates nature-inspired paintings with her kids, including a sunset with palm tree (as of 2023-07-15) and another painting (as of 2023-07-17); painted a lake sunrise around 2022 that is special to her
- Uses painting as emotional expression and relaxation
- Uses pottery as emotional expression and relaxation
- Plays violin
- Runs and reads for self-care
- Has a dog named Luna, a cat named Oliver, and another cat named Bailey; they brighten up her day
- Enjoys outdoor family activities (hiking, picnics, camping)
- Pottery — joined a pottery class on 2023-07-02; takes it as emotional expression and relaxation; creates pieces including a black-and-white flower design bowl, a cup with a dog face, a colorful patterned bowl, and a purple bowl with floral patterns (as of 2023-08-25)

## Key Facts
- Volunteered at a homeless shelter with her family on 2023-08-24
- Ran a charity race for mental health on 2023-05-23
- Recently got new purple/pink running shoes; runs farther than before for stress relief and mental health
- Prioritizes self-care to better support her family
- Favorite childhood book: "Charlotte's Web" — appreciated its themes of friendship and compassion
- Went on a family camping trip in the forest around late June 2023; enjoys outdoor activities with family
- Has 2 younger kids who love nature
- Considers pottery a huge part of her life, not just a hobby — clay brings her great joy
- Flowers were an important part of her wedding decor
- Married — marrying her partner was the best part of her wedding day
- Family has been supportive during her transition
- Creativity and family keep her at peace

## Relations
- Married; has husband and children
- Close friend of Caroline; they chat regularly about life updates

- Actively pursuing counseling/mental health career focused on serving trans people
- Attended LGBTQ+ counseling workshop on 2023-06-23
- Wears a transgender symbol necklace (cross and heart pendant) gifted by her Swedish grandmother when young, representing love, faith, and strength
- Has a hand-painted bowl made by a friend for her 18th birthday (~2013)
- Attended LGBTQ+ pride parade on 2023-08-07; found it inspiring and reaffirmed commitment to fighting for equality
- Joined a mentorship program for LGBTQ youth; mentors a transgender teen just like her
- Planning an LGBTQ art show with her paintings for August 2023
- Creates paintings inspired by LGBTQ+ spaces and community experiences
- Painted a tree with bright sun after visiting an LGBTQ center to capture unity and strength (as of 2023-07-17)
- Recently painted a horse painting, a self-portrait with blue face, and a sunset painting inspired by a beach visit (as of 2023-08-25)
- Drew flowers — one of her favorite subjects
- Went camping in the mountains with family around 2023-06-20; explored nature, roasted marshmallows, and hiked
- Used to go horseback riding with her dad as a child; has always had a love for horses
- Values empathy, self-expression, and personal growth
- Motivated by her own journey and support received to help others
- Passionate about creating safe, inviting spaces for people to grow
- Has a guinea pig named Oscar
- Building a library of children's books (classics, multicultural stories, educational books) for when she has kids
- Pursuing adoption as a single parent (as of 2023-05-25)
- Attended adoption council meeting on 2023-07-14; inspired and determined to adopt
- Applied to adoption agencies on 2023-08-23; took first step towards becoming a mom
- Researching LGBTQ+-inclusive adoption agencies
- Moved from home country approximately 2019 (as of 2023-06-09)
- Experienced a difficult breakup prior to June 2023
- Has a strong support network of friends and family who provided love, guidance, and acceptance during her transition
- Attended an LGBTQ conference on 2023-07-10; felt welcomed and accepted
- Loves reading; books guide, motivate, and help her discover who she is — a huge part of her journey
- Favorite book: "Becoming Nicole" by Amy Ellis Nutt; highly recommends it for its inspiring true story about a trans girl and her family
